cv_scope: Only shared fit_ids; full reader/calibration/timeline/HMM rebuilt for each CV fold. Shared validation is a single diagnostic after best CV params frozen.
cv_policy: 3-fold stratified shuffled seed42 for stratified/checker; 3 expanding whole-date forward folds for temporal. These are inner training folds, not a new outer benchmark track.
training_sources: Only each fold’s train labels/forms plus public lexicon, with its validation text unlabelled. Final fit uses full permitted outer train.
factual_asset_provenance: Fresh full-pipeline CV features per fold. Inner/full outer caches reused only after exact row-pool, benchmark, source and cache hashes match earlier split-scoped run.

leakage_audit.detail: Sanitized feature-builder subprocesses receive training-only forms, runtime labels blank on pending rows. Grid worker receives only fit_ids gold labels and fold-local caches. Gold shared-validation/outer labels and forms remain evaluator-side. No OS filesystem sandbox.

confidence.semantics: Uncalibrated winning-class GB probability; native unsure preserved; no clamp
confidence.calibration: Training-only nested parse-score isotonic; no output calibration
confidence.selection: GridSearchCV mean 3-fold macro F1 after fixed050, all three classes, zero_division=0; tie by ParameterGrid order; refit=False. Never adjust from shared validation or outer test.

hardware.timing: perf_counter native wall time; no constrained container

model_asset_reason: Fits in memory; fold caches, grids and predictions persisted with hashes.
